summary: The authors’ ALAC-versus-WPI result estimates a common diet effect across four brain regions. Zero genes passed their selection rule. The sources reviewed provide no gene-level author result for the registered sex-adjusted hypothalamus contrast, which includes one WPI library excluded from the author fit.

manualReview.summary: The author diet result pools four brain regions and excludes one registered hypothalamus library
manualReview.note: Both analyses use the same P16 formula-fed piglets and WPI baseline. The authors’ DESeq2 model fits a common diet effect across prefrontal cortex, striatum, hippocampus and hypothalamus with sow and tissue terms. The model uses 91 libraries from 23 pigs and omits sex and individual-pig terms. The authors exclude sample 214 (GSM8626987), the hypothalamus library from female WPI PIG8. HypoExplorer includes that library and estimates the sex-adjusted edgeR-QL diet effect using one hypothalamus library per pig (11 ALAC, 12 WPI). The authors’ brain diet CSV contains only a header after selection on BH-adjusted P < 0.05 and absolute apeglm-shrunken log2 fold change > log2(1.5). Figure 5B reports zero upregulated and zero downregulated genes for this four-region diet fit. The Brain section of Supplementary Table 3 and the three nonempty brain CSVs cover ILA subgroups. Table 3 repeats the producer-versus-WPI heading. The authors’ code and CSVs assign ALOX5AP to producers versus WPI and the HBB singleton to nonproducers versus WPI. For ALOX5AP the PDF prints a log2 fold change of −0.62 and the CSV gives +0.621487909284124. For the HBB singleton the PDF prints a base mean of 3336.86 and the CSV gives 336.855389887745. These subgroup rows supply no paired effect or test for the registered diet contrast.

verificationReview.reason: The author diet CSV is a thresholded, header-only export from a four-region DESeq2 model adjusted for sow and region. HypoExplorer fits sex-adjusted edgeR-QL to hypothalamus alone, including the excluded WPI library 214. The nonempty brain tables estimate ILA subgroup effects across regions. Author effects, P values and FDR for the registered contrast remain unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if a gene-level ALAC-versus-WPI result for P16 hypothalamus becomes available with both ALAC ILA subgroups combined. Use the sample IDs, handling of library 214 and documented sex handling to assess compatibility with the registered effect. A selected-gene result supports comparison only for the genes supplied.
